title: feat(devx): check:package-naming — packages/services/ packages are service-NAME after their directory, and the plugin- prefix is frozen at ten (#29710)

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8QModZH3Kxarp5xssNiWbVr)_
Fixes #29710

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:新增门禁 `check:package-naming`。`packages/services/` 下每个包必须叫 `@objectstack/service-名字` 且目录名与包名一致;`@objectstack/plugin-*` 这组名字冻结在今天的十个,新包再用 `plugin-` 前缀直接红。
- 为什么改:Warren 2026-11-03 的裁决「应该用 service-*，包括如何制定仓库规则，避免类似的问题」「plugin- 太笼统，是不是建议逐渐退役这个名字」。推送通道差点按 ADR-0012 叫 `plugin-notification-push`;包名一旦发布就收不回。
- 风险与回滚:只读 `package.json`,不构建、不联网、亚秒级;今天的树全绿。不改名、不挪任何现有包。回滚即撤 PR。
- 先看:① `scripts/check-package-naming.mjs` 的 `judge()` 与 `FROZEN_PLUGIN_NAMES`;② `.github/workflows/lint.yml` 新增的一步(Tier H);③ 同文件 self-test 的两个 fixture 用例。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:package-naming`,应见 self-test 15 例通过,随后一行 ✓,写明 129 个包、18 个 service、恰好 10 个冻结名。
- 需要你做的:审阅并落地(含 `.github/workflows/lint.yml`,Tier H 需维护者合并)。

## What changes

- **New gate `scripts/check-package-naming.mjs`**, on `scripts/workspace-enumerator.mjs` (the one parse of `pnpm-workspace.yaml`). Two rules over every workspace manifest:
  - `[services-prefix]` / `[dir-mismatch]`: every package whose directory sits directly under `packages/services/` is named `@objectstack/service-NAME`, and NAME with the prefix is its directory basename.
  - `[plugin-prefix]` / `[stale-row]`: the set of `@objectstack/plugin-*` names is a shrink-only ratchet, `FROZEN_PLUGIN_NAMES`, frozen at the ten the tree carries today: `approvals`, `audit`, `auth`, `dev`, `email`, `hono-server`, `pinyin-search`, `security`, `sharing`, `webhooks`. A new name reds with the remedy "name it by its kind" (`service-`, `connector-`, `driver-`, `embedder-`, `knowledge-`). Growing the set is refused outright, not offered as a remedy. A frozen name the tree no longer carries reds too, so the set can only shrink.
  - A lit control (at least 50 packages, `@objectstack/spec` present, at least one member under `packages/services/`) makes an enumeration that stops reading the tree exit 2, never 0. `--root DIR` judges another checkout.
  - `--self-test` arm: 15 table-driven cases with the sibling battery floor (pattern of `check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs`), including two that build a real fixture workspace on disk and judge it through the enumerator.
- **Wiring**: `check:package-naming` in the root `package.json` (`--self-test` then the run), and one step in `.github/workflows/lint.yml` right after `check:workspace-manifest-cycles`, same shape (`continue-on-error: true`, rationale comment pointing at the header). There is no `check:all` aggregator in this repo, so the workflow step is the only CI wiring; the seat ruled option A, and that makes this PR Tier H.
- **Scope, stated**: the 18 `@object-ui/plugin-*` packages under `ui/packages/` are a separate scope and are NOT in the frozen set (seat ruling). A `@objectstack/service-*` package outside `packages/services/` is not judged (0 today). No existing package is renamed or moved.
- No changeset: the diff is `scripts/**`, the root manifest and a workflow, none of which publishes (`skip-changeset`).

## Tests

- `node scripts/check-package-naming.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, `✓ check-package-naming self-test: 15 cases pass.`
- `node scripts/check-package-naming.mjs` on this branch: exit 0, `✓ check-package-naming: 129 workspace package(s); all 18 in packages/services/ are @objectstack/service-* named after their directory; the @objectstack/plugin-* set is exactly the 10 frozen names.`
- Red-first on the real tree (fixtures written into the worktree, then removed; `git status` clean afterwards): `packages/services/plugin-x` named `@objectstack/plugin-x` plus an eleventh `packages/plugins/plugin-notification-push` gave exit 1 with three findings: `[services-prefix] packages/services/plugin-x`, `[plugin-prefix] packages/plugins/plugin-notification-push`, `[plugin-prefix] packages/services/plugin-x`.
- #29041's `service-push` branch does not exist yet (no branch or PR for it on the remote at the time of writing), so the gate has not been run on it: NOT MEASURED. `@objectstack/service-push` in `packages/services/service-push` is the shape the gate accepts; `--root` lets the seat run it on that checkout.

## Acceptance notes

- The frozen set is meant to equal the ten named in #29709's rule text; that card runs in parallel, and the seat holds the two in step.
- `check:entry-guard` caught the first draft calling `main()` at top level while exporting `judge`/`readRows`; the second commit puts the dispatch behind `isEntrypoint` from `invoked-as.mjs`.
